records.name: Rusty Chain Mail~
records.why: 3.0.9 AC 14 and -8, the same base AC as 3.0.9 Chain Mail; 4.2 Chain Mail is 32, so both scale by 32/14

records.name: Double Chain Mail~
records.why: 3.0.9 AC 16, the same as 3.0.9 Augmented Chain Mail, which is 42 in 4.2

records.name: & Gnomish Shovel~
records.why: 3.0.9 digging 2; 4.2 writes digging as DIG_1 to DIG_3, and its Shovel (3.0.9 digging 1) is DIG_1

records.name: & Dwarven Shovel~
records.why: 3.0.9 digging 3, as the 3.0.9 Mattock, which is DIG_3 in 4.2

records.name: & Dwarven Pick~
records.why: 3.0.9 digging 3, as the 3.0.9 Mattock, which is DIG_3 in 4.2
